attributes.blockerTitle: 22 layer-03 alias rows may double-count the gap
attributes.detail: Layer 03 carries bare original-table labels (Grid, List, Chart, Create, Notify, Run…) whose precise siblings exist as separate cells (Cards Grid, Card List, Line Chart…). They read as Missing and inflate the layer-03 numbers on this dashboard; the demand-side audit speaks in the same bare names, so they are not pure noise. Resolution is open (boxel-catalog/docs/bottom-up-block-strategy.md §7.5) — until then, read layer 03 coverage with that caveat.
